content.text:
The bug was in `truncate` in `src/lib/strings.js`. It cut the text to `max` characters and then added the ellipsis, so the result came out longer than `max`.

The fix is one line. It now cuts to `max - ellipsis.length` characters before adding the ellipsis:

```js
return text.slice(0, max - ellipsis.length) + ellipsis;
```

With this change, `node --test` passes all 13 tests. I didn't edit any tests.
